questions.q: A logistics firm dispatches 15 Light-Duty trucks and 6 Heavy-Duty trucks for a specific route. The payload capacity of a Light-Duty truck is 20% of a Heavy-Duty truck, yielding a combined total payload of 225 tons. If the payload capacity of the Heavy-Duty trucks is enhanced by 12%, by what percentage must the fleet of Light-Duty trucks be reduced to keep the overall payload exactly at 225 tons? (Assuming the capacity of Light-Duty trucks and the count of Heavy-Duty trucks are strictly constant).
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM/Deviation over $A \times B + C \times D = K$ Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, yahan Total Payload = Trucks $\times$ Capacity hai. Overall target fix rakhna hai (225 tons). Heavy trucks ki capacity 12% badhi aur unki sankhya same hai, toh Heavy trucks ka total payload exactly 12% badhega. Jo extra wazan Heavy trucks uthayenge, exactly utna hi wazan Light trucks ko kam uthana padega taki total fix rahe. Seedha initial payload ratio nikal aur shift (deviation) balance kar de. 225 ka exam me koi kaam nahi hai, bas time-waste trap hai! Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Seedha product ratio nikal kar deviation ko balance kar de, exact data ki zarurat hi nahi hai. Mathematically :-
$\text{Capacity Ratio (Light : Heavy)} = 20\% = 1 : 5$
$\text{Payload Ratio (Light : Heavy)} = (15 \times 1) : (6 \times 5) = 15 : 30 = 1 : 2$
$\text{Extra payload by Heavy} = 12\% \text{ of } 2 = +0.24 \text{ units}$
$\text{Loss required by Light} = -0.24 \text{ units}$
$\% \text{ reduction in Light} = \frac{0.24}{1} \times 100 = 24\%$ Method 2 (Concept Builder): Variable $x$ maan kar total payload equate kar, naya target nikal aur percentage check kar. Mathematically :-
$\text{Let Capacity Light} = 1x, \text{Capacity Heavy} = 5x$
$\text{Total Payload} = 15(1x) + 6(5x) = 45x$
$45x = 225 \implies x = 5$
$\text{Initial Payload Light} = 15 \times 5 = 75$
$\text{Initial Payload Heavy} = 6 \times 25 = 150$
$\text{New Capacity Heavy} = 25 \times 1.12 = 28$
$\text{New Payload Heavy} = 6 \times 28 = 168$
$\text{Required Payload Light} = 225 - 168 = 57$
$\text{New Count of Light Trucks} = \frac{57}{5} = 11.4 \text{ trucks}$
$\% \text{ Reduction} = \frac{15 - 11.4}{15} \times 100 = 24\%$ Exam Takeaway: Method 1 is the ultimate ranker hack. Jab variable $A \times B$ ke form me ho aur ek dimension constant rakhi jaye, toh directly final product ke ratio par base value set karo aur shift ko transfer kar do. Absolute base data (225) ko haath bhi nahi lagana hai.
StepZero-Sum Hack Action
1. Base RatioFind final aggregate ratio ($L : H = 1 : 2$)
2. Find DeviationCalculate exact units gained ($12\%$ of $2 = +0.24$)
3. Balance & ScaleShift the same loss over Light's base ($-0.24 / 1 = 24\%$)

questions.q: What will be the difference in population 3 years ago and 2 years ago of a town, whose current population is 190000 and which is increasing at a rate of 25% every year?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, rate $25\%$ yani fraction me $\frac{1}{4}$ ka increment hai. Jump multiplier $\frac{5}{4}$ banega. 3 saal ka gap hai, toh seedha $4^3$ aur $5^3$ ka base assume kar. Aur sabse main hack—jab options set hi itne farzi hain toh calculation kyu karni? Numerator me 16 baitha hoga.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Timeframe: '3 years ago' se 'Current' = 3 Jumps. Exact value alag karke Divisibility check kar lo. Hardly 10-15 seconds lagenge isme!

Mathematically :-
$$ Ratio = 25\\% = \\frac{1}{4} \\implies Multiplier = \\frac{5}{4} \\\\ Pop_{-3} = 4^3 = 64 \\\\ Pop_{0} = 5^3 = 125 = 190000 \\\\ Pop_{-2} = 64 \\times \\frac{5}{4} = 80 \\\\ Diff = 80 - 64 = 16 \\\\ Value = 190000 \\times \\frac{16}{125} = 24320 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder - Clearing the Timeline Trap): Bohot bache isme faste hain ki power 3 kyu aayi agar timeline me 4 time-points involve hain. Isko Fence Post Error kehte hain.

Mathematically :-
$$ P_{current} = P_{-3} \\times (1.25)^3 \\\\ 190000 = P_{-3} \\times \\frac{125}{64} \\implies P_{-3} = 97280 \\\\ P_{-2} = 97280 \\times 1.25 = 121600 \\\\ Diff = 121600 - 97280 = 24320 $$

Exam Takeaway: Timeline aur assumed units ka direct relation hamesha clear rakhna chahiye, aur hamesha divisibility check karni chahiye final step se pehle.

B. 2 Years Ago (After 1st Jump)2. 80 units
C. 1 Year Ago (After 2nd Jump)3. 100 units

questions.q: Rahul had to appear for a test in four subjects. In the first three subjects the maximum marks were 50 each, in which Rahul secured 60% on an average. In the fourth subject Rahul scored 54 marks and his overall percentage is 64%. What were the maximum marks in the fourth subject?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool Triggered: Unitary Scaling / Basic Arithmetic

The 'Pen-Free' Observation First: 3 subjects ka total 150. Usme 60% laya (yaani 90 marks). 4th me 54 marks. Total marks 144 jo ki 64% hai total max ka. Sidha equation dikh rahi hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Total scored = 90 (first 3) + 54 (4th) = 144. Ye 144 overall 64% hai. So, $64\% = 144 \implies 100\% = \frac{144}{64} \times 100 = 225$ (Digital sum check: $9/1 = 9$, 225 ka digital sum bhi 9, match). Total max marks 225. Pehle 3 subjects ka max 150 tha. Toh 4th ka hoga $225 - 150 = 75$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Let 4th subject max marks be x. $\frac{90 + 54}{150 + x} = \frac{64}{100}$. Solve for x. Wahi 75 aayega.

Future Exam Takeaway: C9 (Digital Sum) verification step me fraction divide karte time bahut useful hai, confidence deta hai!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Area humesha 2D hota hai. Ye sabse safe hack hai. Mathematically :- $$ A_1:A_2 = 100:144 \\ S_1:S_2 = \sqrt{100}:\sqrt{144} = 10:12 \\ \% \text{ Increase} = \frac{12-10}{10} \times 100 = 20\% $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Let side increase be $x\%$. Quadratic form hoke time jayega. Mathematically :- $$ x + x + \frac{x^2}{100} = 44 \\ 2x + \frac{x^2}{100} = 44 \\ x^2 + 200x - 4400 = 0 \\ (x - 20)(x + 220) = 0 \implies x = 20 $$

Exam Takeaway: 2D aur 3D changes ko wapas 1D side ratio me badalna ho toh humesha square root ya cube root le kar base scaling kiya kar.

questions.q: In a biological study of 2023, a mutant virus colony had a total population of 8,57,432, and exactly 14.1% of them were highly active. In 2024, the total population surged to 11,48,958 and the active percentage rate bumped to 17.2%. What is the approximate percentage change in the absolute number of highly active viruses?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, TCS exam mein aise gande numbers sirf tumhara time kharab karne ke liye deta hai. Active viruses = Population $\times$ Rate ($A \times B = K$). Jab dono multiplier change hote hain, toh net effect successive formula se nikalta hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Options mein gap acha hai, toh hum exact values ko goli maarenge aur sirf approximate percentage shifts nikalenge! Tick maar aur aage badh!

Mathematically :-
$$ \\Delta Pop \\approx \\frac{11.48 - 8.57}{8.57} \\times 100 \\approx 34\\% \\\\ \\Delta Rate \\approx \\frac{17.2 - 14.1}{14.1} \\times 100 \\approx 22\\% \\\\ Net \\ \\Delta = 34 + 22 + \\frac{34 \\times 22}{100} \\\\ = 56 + 7.48 = 63.48\\% \\approx 64\\% $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Absolute numbers nikal kar subtract karke percentage generate kar. Boht calculation hai.

Mathematically :-
$$ Active_{2023} = 857432 \\times 0.141 = 120897.9 \\\\ Active_{2024} = 1148958 \\times 0.172 = 197620.7 \\\\ \\% \\Delta = \\frac{197620.7 - 120897.9}{120897.9} \\times 100 = 63.46\\% $$

Exam Takeaway: Data Interpretation (DI) aur Percentage ke gande sums jahan $A \times B = K$ lag raha ho, wahan exact calculation pap hai. Hamesha base aur shift ka approximate ratio nikal ke successive change lapaad diya kar.

questions.q: An ore contains 25% of an alloy that has 90% iron. Other than this, in the remaining 75% of the ore, there is no iron. How many kilograms of the ore are needed to obtain 60 kg of pure iron?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 1. CPR (Constant Product Ratio)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, poore ore me loha kahan se aa raha hai? Sirf uss $25\%$ wale hisse se. Aur usme bhi pura loha nahi hai, bas uska $90\%$ hai. Toh seedha net percentage nikal le iron ka.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Overall iron ka percentage nikal aur seedha usko $60$ ke barabar rakh de!

Mathematically :-
$$\text{Net Iron} = 25\% \times 90\% = 22.5\%$$
$$X \times 22.5\% = 60$$
$$X = \frac{60}{0.225} = \frac{60,000}{225} = 266.67$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Maan le Total Ore $100x$ hai aur basic steps follow kar.

Mathematically :-
$$\text{Alloy} = 25x$$
$$\text{Iron} = 90\% \text{ of } 25x = 22.5x$$
$$22.5x = 60 \implies x = \frac{60}{22.5}$$
$$100x = 100 \times \frac{60}{22.5} \approx 266.67$$

Exam Takeaway: Percentage of percentage dikhe toh hamesha unhe multiply karke ek single net percentage bana liya kar, bahut time bachega.

questions.q: A and B contested in an election in a village. A got y% of the total number of votes and B got (y - 48)% of the total number of votes and the ratio of the total number of votes obtained by A to B is 15:11. Find the total number of voters in the village, if (4y/9)% of the total number of votes is 6000.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dono percentages ka base ek hi hai (Total number of votes), toh hum unke ratios ko directly equate kar sakte hain, koi alag assumption ki zaroorat nahi hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai TestRipper, isko fauran cross-multiply kar:
$$ \frac{A}{B} = \frac{y}{y - 48} = \frac{15}{11} $$
$$11y = 15y - 720 \implies 4y = 720 \implies y = 180$$
Ab aakhiri line pakad: $(\frac{4y}{9})\% = \frac{4 \times 180}{9}\% = 80\%$.
Total ka $80\% = 6000$ hai, toh $100\% = \frac{6000}{80} \times 100 = 7500$.
Wait kar, options me toh 7500 hai hi nahi! Ye hote hain SSC ke faulty questions. Aise me options me sabse closest value test kar. Jaise 6750 ka 80% nikalega toh 5400 aayega (closest logical fit to language anomaly). Option 6750 yahan real exam me sabse apt trick guess mana jayega.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Faulty questions har saal nikalte hain TCS me. Apna math pakka rakh aur closest option ya error approach par strike kar.

questions.q: In an election between two candidates , (x + 15) % of the voters cast their votes, out of which 13,875 votes were declared invalid. A candidate got 55,500 votes which were (x-5)% of the total voters in the voter list. Total number of voters enrolled in the voter list is 1,38,750, then find how many valid votes were casted?
questions.s:
Tool Triggered: 5. Unitary Scaling

The "Pen-Free" Observation First:
Dekh bhai, numbers bade hain toh pehle base pakad. $1\%$ of $1,38,750$ = $1387.5$. Candidate ko $55,500$ mile, ye kitna percent hua? $55500 / 1387.5 = 40\%$. Yani $x - 5 = 40 \implies x = 45$. Casted votes = $(45 + 15)\% = 60\%$. Total ka $60\%$ nikalo aur invalid hata do.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
Percentage Mapping.

Mathematically :-
$$ 1\% \text{ of } 138750 = 1387.5 \\ (x-5)\% = \frac{55500}{138750} \times 100 = 40\% \\ x - 5 = 40 \implies x = 45 \\ \text{Casted \%} = x + 15 = 60\% \\ \text{Casted Votes} = 138750 \times 0.6 = 83250 \\ \text{Valid Casted} = 83250 - 13875 = 69375 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder):
Step by step raw multiplication.

Mathematically :-
$$ \frac{(x-5)}{100} \times 138750 = 55500 \\ x - 5 = \frac{5550000}{138750} = 40 \implies x = 45 \\ \text{Total Casted} = \frac{60}{100} \times 138750 = 83250 \\ \text{Valid} = \text{Total Casted} - \text{Invalid} \\ \text{Valid} = 83250 - 13875 = 69375 $$

Exam Takeaway: Basic observation 1% ki value nikalne par questions turant shrink ho jate hain.

questions.q: In a village, two contestants (A & B) are contesting in an election. 70% of the registered voters cast their votes in the election and A wins the election by 400 votes. If A had received 12.5% less votes, A’s votes would have been equal to B’s votes. How many registered voters are there in the village?
questions.s:
Tool Triggered: 5. Unitary Scaling

The "Pen-Free" Observation First:
Dekh bhai, $12.5\%$ ka fraction $1/8$ hai. A ne apne 1/8 hissa lose kiya, wahi hissa B ke paas chala gaya. Toh A aur B ka equality equation banta hai: $A - A/8 = B + A/8$. Seedha B = $3A/4$. Ratio $A:B$ = 4:3. Margin 1 unit ka 400. Total cast 7 unit = 2800. Ye total ka $70\%$ hai. Toh 100% = 4000.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
Value transfer logic.

Mathematically :-
$$ A - \frac{1}{8}A = B + \frac{1}{8}A \\ \frac{7}{8}A = B + \frac{1}{8}A \implies B = \frac{6}{8}A = \frac{3}{4}A \\ \frac{A}{B} = \frac{4}{3} \\ \text{Margin} = 4 - 3 = 1 \text{ unit} \\ 1 \text{ unit} = 400 \implies \text{Casted} (7 \text{ units}) = 2800 \\ 70\% \text{ of Reg} = 2800 \implies \text{Reg} = \frac{2800}{0.7} = 4000 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder):
Standard percentage equation.

Mathematically :-
$$ \text{Condition: } A - 12.5\% A = B + 12.5\% A \\ 87.5\% A = B + 12.5\% A \implies B = 75\% A \\ \text{Diff} = A - B = A - 0.75A = 0.25A \\ 0.25 A = 400 \implies A = 1600 \\ B = 0.75 \times 1600 = 1200 \\ \text{Total Cast} = A + B = 1600 + 1200 = 2800 \\ \text{Reg} = \frac{2800 \times 100}{70} = 4000 $$

Exam Takeaway: Election questions me vote transfer ki theory directly fractions par execute karo.

questions.q: The ratio of the number of boys and girls in a school is 7:5. If $65\%$ of the boys and $81\%$ of the girls are scholarship holders, then the exact percentage of students who do NOT get a scholarship is:
questions.s:
The "Pen-Free" Observation First:

Dekh bhai, 'do NOT get scholarship' pucha hai. Pehle JSM laga ke total getting nikal, aur phir $100\%$ se minus kar de. Fraction minus karne me time waste nahi karna hai.

Method 1 (JSM Ninja Technique):

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Base } (\text{Getting}) = 65\% \\ \text{Extra in Girls} = 81\% - 65\% = +16\% \\ \text{Avg } (\text{Getting}) = 65\% + \frac{5 \times 16\%}{12} = 65\% + \frac{20}{3}\% = 71\frac{2}{3}\% \\ \text{NOT Getting} = 100\% - 71\frac{2}{3}\% \\ = (100 - 72) + (1 - \frac{2}{3}) = 28\frac{1}{3}\% $$

Exam Takeaway: Calculation mein jab bhi 100 mein se mixed fraction minus karna ho, toh integer ko ek aage badha ke subtract kar, aur fraction ka bacha gap chipka de!

questions.q: Two candidates P and Q are contesting elections in a city. $80\%$ of the registered voters voted in the election and P won the election by 160 votes. If Q had got $25\%$ more votes then the result of the election would have been a tie, then how many people did not vote?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 4. Cross-Product Method / Ratio Balancing Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, thoda ghuma hua sawal hai. Tie ka matlab hota hai dono ke votes barabar ho jana. Par 'if Q got 25% more' ka assumption wahan ke fixed valid votes me P ka nuksan nahi dikha raha, bas usne bahar se votes cover kiye aise treat kar. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): P aur Q ka margin 160 tha. Yaani $P - Q = 160$. Tie karne ke liye Q ko P ke barabar aana hai, yani usey aur 160 votes chahiye the. Question kehta hai ki agar usko $25\%$ jyada milte toh tie hota. Iska matlab uske existing votes ka $25\%$ hi $160$ votes ke barabar hai! Yani $25\%$ of Q = 160 $\implies$ Q ke asal vote = $160 \times 4 = 640$. Toh P ke vote $= 640 + 160 = 800$. Total valid vote kitne pade? $800 + 640 = 1440$. Oye wait, result of election as tie meaning agar unhi casted votes me change hota toh? 'If Q had got 25% more votes... tie' means from the same pool. P se Q ki taraf shift hue! Agar shift hue toh margin cover hoga. Q ko mile $25\%$ zyada yani $0.25Q$. P ko itna hi loss hua hoga, tab dono barabar. Yani original gap $P - Q = 2 \times 0.25Q = 0.5Q$. Margin $160$ diya hai. $0.5Q = 160 \implies Q = 320$. P $= 480$. Total cast = $480 + 320 = 800$. Ye valid votes the (registered ke $80\%$). Toh register $= 1000$. Didn't vote ($20\%$) $= 200$. Concept hila dene wala sawal tha ye! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Equations bana le. P + Q = Total Voted. P - Q = 160. Nayi condition: $Q + 0.25Q = P - 0.25Q \implies P = 1.5Q$. Is value ko daal de $P - Q = 160$ me. $1.5Q - Q = 160 \implies 0.5Q = 160 \implies Q = 320$. Uske baad upar wali calculations lag jaayengi. Exam Takeaway: Election tie wale cases me jiska badh raha hai, utna hi dusre ka ghata kar gap cover karna hota hai!

questions.q: Rajan spent $10\%$ of his salary on rent. He spent $20\%$ of the remaining part of the salary on transport. After which he spent $40\%$ of the balance of the salary on food. Further, he spent $80\%$ of the balance on various bills. He deposits $\text{Rs. } 5000$ in the bank and kept the remaining $\text{Rs. } 1480$ for his own petty expenditure. Find his monthly salary (in Rs.).
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction) Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, bar-bar 'remaining part' likha hai, seedha Successive Change ka chain lagana hai. End me jo bhi paisa bacha (bank me daala + khud rakha) wo sab final remainder hai. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Final amount bacha $5000 + 1480 = 6480$. Salary ko $S$ maan aur seedha bachi hui fractions likh: $10\%$ kharch $\to \frac{9}{10}$ bacha, $20\% \to \frac{4}{5}$, $40\% \to \frac{3}{5}$, $80\% \to \frac{1}{5}$. Equation bani: $S \times \frac{9}{10} \times \frac{4}{5} \times \frac{3}{5} \times \frac{1}{5} = 6480$. Upar walon ko multiply karega toh $9 \times 4 \times 3 = 108$ aayega. $108$ se $6480$ kata $60$ baar me. Neeche ka base $10 \times 5 \times 5 \times 5 = 1250$ udhar jake multiply hua. $S = 60 \times 1250 = 75000$. Secondon me uda diya bhai! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Ya fir aise decimals me likh: $S \times 0.9 \times 0.8 \times 0.6 \times 0.2 = 6480$. $9 \times 8 \times 6 \times 2 = 864$ aayega. Yani $S \times 0.0864 = 6480$. $S = \frac{6480}{0.0864} = 75000$. Digital Sum bhi check kar sakta hai par itna sidha cut raha hai ki zaroorat nahi. Exam Takeaway: 'Of the remaining' padhte hi fractions ki chain bana kar directly equate kar diya kar.
Fraction ChainFinal Equate
$\frac{9}{10} \times \frac{4}{5} \times \frac{3}{5} \times \frac{1}{5}$$\frac{108}{1250}$
$S \times \frac{108}{1250} = 6480$$S = 75000$

questions.q: Two candidates contested an election. 10% of people on the voting list did not vote and 60 votes recorded were rejected as illegal. The majority of successful candidate was 308 and it was found that he had been supported by 47% of the whole number of the voter's list. What were the total votes.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, winner ko total ka 47% mila hai. Loser ko bache hue valid votes milenge. Ye jo 60 invalid votes hain, ye directly loser ke khate se katenge jisse winner ka margin badh jayega.



Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Total votes ko 100x maan le. Winner le gaya 47x. Toh baaki bacha 43x. Agar sab sahi hota toh margin 4x hota. Par 60 votes invalid the, isiliye margin $308 - 60 = 248$ reh gaya. Seedha $4\% = 248 \implies 1\% = 62$. Toh total $100\% = 6200$. 10 second ka khel hai!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic se dekhe toh Total = $x$. Valid $= 0.9x - 60$. Winner $= 0.47x$. Loser ko mila $(0.9x - 60) - 0.47x = 0.43x - 60$. Ab equation bana: $0.47x - (0.43x - 60) = 308 \implies 0.04x = 248$.

Exam Takeaway: CGL me jab bhi absolute invalid votes diye hon, unhe margin me se minus karke percentage ke barabar rakh de.

Nayi saving us se 5% zyada hai. $2032$ ka $5\%$ nikal (yani $\frac{1}{20}$). $2032 / 20 = 101.6$. Answer done! Method 2 (Concept Builder): 100 maan ke kar le. Income 100, Exp 60, Sav 40. Nayi Income 120, Naya Exp $60 \times 1.3 = 78$. Nayi Sav = $120 - 78 = 42$. Pehle Sav 40 thi, ab 42 ho gayi. Percentage increase $5\%$. Phir value nikal le. questions_hin.q_hi: A logistics firm dispatches 15 Light-Duty trucks and 6 Heavy-Duty trucks for a specific route. The payload capacity of a Light-Duty truck is 20% of a Heavy-Duty truck, yielding a combined total payload of 225 tons. If the payload capacity of the Heavy-Duty trucks is enhanced by 12%, by what percentage must the fleet of Light-Duty trucks be reduced to keep the overall payload exactly at 225 tons? (Assuming the capacity of Light-Duty trucks and the count of Heavy-Duty trucks are strictly constant).
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM/Deviation over $A \times B + C \times D = K$ Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, yahan Total Payload = Trucks $\times$ Capacity hai. Overall target fix rakhna hai (225 tons). Heavy trucks ki capacity 12% badhi aur unki sankhya same hai, toh Heavy trucks ka total payload exactly 12% badhega. Jo extra wazan Heavy trucks uthayenge, exactly utna hi wazan Light trucks ko kam uthana padega taki total fix rahe. Seedha initial payload ratio nikal aur shift (deviation) balance kar de. 225 ka exam me koi kaam nahi hai, bas time-waste trap hai! Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Seedha product ratio nikal kar deviation ko balance kar de, exact data ki zarurat hi nahi hai. Mathematically :-
$\text{Capacity Ratio (Light : Heavy)} = 20\% = 1 : 5$
$\text{Payload Ratio (Light : Heavy)} = (15 \times 1) : (6 \times 5) = 15 : 30 = 1 : 2$
$\text{Extra payload by Heavy} = 12\% \text{ of } 2 = +0.24 \text{ units}$
$\text{Loss required by Light} = -0.24 \text{ units}$
$\% \text{ reduction in Light} = \frac{0.24}{1} \times 100 = 24\%$ Method 2 (Concept Builder): Variable $x$ maan kar total payload equate kar, naya target nikal aur percentage check kar. Mathematically :-
$\text{Let Capacity Light} = 1x, \text{Capacity Heavy} = 5x$
$\text{Total Payload} = 15(1x) + 6(5x) = 45x$
$45x = 225 \implies x = 5$
$\text{Initial Payload Light} = 15 \times 5 = 75$
$\text{Initial Payload Heavy} = 6 \times 25 = 150$
$\text{New Capacity Heavy} = 25 \times 1.12 = 28$
$\text{New Payload Heavy} = 6 \times 28 = 168$
$\text{Required Payload Light} = 225 - 168 = 57$
$\text{New Count of Light Trucks} = \frac{57}{5} = 11.4 \text{ trucks}$
$\% \text{ Reduction} = \frac{15 - 11.4}{15} \times 100 = 24\%$ Exam Takeaway: Method 1 is the ultimate ranker hack. Jab variable $A \times B$ ke form me ho aur ek dimension constant rakhi jaye, toh directly final product ke ratio par base value set karo aur shift ko transfer kar do. Absolute base data (225) ko haath bhi nahi lagana hai.
StepZero-Sum Hack Action
1. Base RatioFind final aggregate ratio ($L : H = 1 : 2$)
2. Find DeviationCalculate exact units gained ($12\%$ of $2 = +0.24$)
3. Balance & ScaleShift the same loss over Light's base ($-0.24 / 1 = 24\%$)

questions_hin.q_hi: What will be the difference in population 3 years ago and 2 years ago of a town, whose current population is 190000 and which is increasing at a rate of 25% every year?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, rate $25\%$ yani fraction me $\frac{1}{4}$ ka increment hai. Jump multiplier $\frac{5}{4}$ banega. 3 saal ka gap hai, toh seedha $4^3$ aur $5^3$ ka base assume kar. Aur sabse main hack—jab options set hi itne farzi hain toh calculation kyu karni? Numerator me 16 baitha hoga.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Timeframe: '3 years ago' se 'Current' = 3 Jumps. Exact value alag karke Divisibility check kar lo. Hardly 10-15 seconds lagenge isme!

Mathematically :-
$$ Ratio = 25\\% = \\frac{1}{4} \\implies Multiplier = \\frac{5}{4} \\\\ Pop_{-3} = 4^3 = 64 \\\\ Pop_{0} = 5^3 = 125 = 190000 \\\\ Pop_{-2} = 64 \\times \\frac{5}{4} = 80 \\\\ Diff = 80 - 64 = 16 \\\\ Value = 190000 \\times \\frac{16}{125} = 24320 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder - Clearing the Timeline Trap): Bohot bache isme faste hain ki power 3 kyu aayi agar timeline me 4 time-points involve hain. Isko Fence Post Error kehte hain.

Mathematically :-
$$ P_{current} = P_{-3} \\times (1.25)^3 \\\\ 190000 = P_{-3} \\times \\frac{125}{64} \\implies P_{-3} = 97280 \\\\ P_{-2} = 97280 \\times 1.25 = 121600 \\\\ Diff = 121600 - 97280 = 24320 $$

Exam Takeaway: Timeline aur assumed units ka direct relation hamesha clear rakhna chahiye, aur hamesha divisibility check karni chahiye final step se pehle.

questions_hin.q_hi: An ore contains 25% of an alloy that has 90% iron. Other than this, in the remaining 75% of the ore, there is no iron. How many kilograms of the ore are needed to obtain 60 kg of pure iron?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: 1. CPR (Constant Product Ratio)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, poore ore me loha kahan se aa raha hai? Sirf uss $25\%$ wale hisse se. Aur usme bhi pura loha nahi hai, bas uska $90\%$ hai. Toh seedha net percentage nikal le iron ka.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Overall iron ka percentage nikal aur seedha usko $60$ ke barabar rakh de!

Mathematically :-
$$\text{Net Iron} = 25\% \times 90\% = 22.5\%$$
$$X \times 22.5\% = 60$$
$$X = \frac{60}{0.225} = \frac{60,000}{225} = 266.67$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Maan le Total Ore $100x$ hai aur basic steps follow kar.

Mathematically :-
$$\text{Alloy} = 25x$$

questions_hin.q_hi: In an election between two candidates , (x + 15) % of the voters cast their votes, out of which 13,875 votes were declared invalid. A candidate got 55,500 votes which were (x-5)% of the total voters in the voter list. Total number of voters enrolled in the voter list is 1,38,750, then find how many valid votes were casted?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Tool Triggered: 5. Unitary Scaling

The "Pen-Free" Observation First:
Dekh bhai, numbers bade hain toh pehle base pakad. $1\%$ of $1,38,750$ = $1387.5$. Candidate ko $55,500$ mile, ye kitna percent hua? $55500 / 1387.5 = 40\%$. Yani $x - 5 = 40 \implies x = 45$. Casted votes = $(45 + 15)\% = 60\%$. Total ka $60\%$ nikalo aur invalid hata do.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
Percentage Mapping.

Mathematically :-
$$ 1\% \text{ of } 138750 = 1387.5 \\ (x-5)\% = \frac{55500}{138750} \times 100 = 40\% \\ x - 5 = 40 \implies x = 45 \\ \text{Casted \%} = x + 15 = 60\% \\ \text{Casted Votes} = 138750 \times 0.6 = 83250 \\ \text{Valid Casted} = 83250 - 13875 = 69375 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder):
Step by step raw multiplication.

Mathematically :-
$$ \frac{(x-5)}{100} \times 138750 = 55500 \\ x - 5 = \frac{5550000}{138750} = 40 \implies x = 45 \\ \text{Total Casted} = \frac{60}{100} \times 138750 = 83250 \\ \text{Valid} = \text{Total Casted} - \text{Invalid} \\ \text{Valid} = 83250 - 13875 = 69375 $$

Exam Takeaway: Basic observation 1% ki value nikalne par questions turant shrink ho jate hain.

questions_hin.q_hi: In a village, two contestants (A & B) are contesting in an election. 70% of the registered voters cast their votes in the election and A wins the election by 400 votes. If A had received 12.5% less votes, A’s votes would have been equal to B’s votes. How many registered voters are there in the village?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Tool Triggered: 5. Unitary Scaling

The "Pen-Free" Observation First:
Dekh bhai, $12.5\%$ ka fraction $1/8$ hai. A ne apne 1/8 hissa lose kiya, wahi hissa B ke paas chala gaya. Toh A aur B ka equality equation banta hai: $A - A/8 = B + A/8$. Seedha B = $3A/4$. Ratio $A:B$ = 4:3. Margin 1 unit ka 400. Total cast 7 unit = 2800. Ye total ka $70\%$ hai. Toh 100% = 4000.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
Value transfer logic.

Mathematically :-
$$ A - \frac{1}{8}A = B + \frac{1}{8}A \\ \frac{7}{8}A = B + \frac{1}{8}A \implies B = \frac{6}{8}A = \frac{3}{4}A \\ \frac{A}{B} = \frac{4}{3} \\ \text{Margin} = 4 - 3 = 1 \text{ unit} \\ 1 \text{ unit} = 400 \implies \text{Casted} (7 \text{ units}) = 2800 \\ 70\% \text{ of Reg} = 2800 \implies \text{Reg} = \frac{2800}{0.7} = 4000 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder):
Standard percentage equation.

Mathematically :-
$$ \text{Condition: } A - 12.5\% A = B + 12.5\% A \\ 87.5\% A = B + 12.5\% A \implies B = 75\% A \\ \text{Diff} = A - B = A - 0.75A = 0.25A \\ 0.25 A = 400 \implies A = 1600 \\ B = 0.75 \times 1600 = 1200 \\ \text{Total Cast} = A + B = 1600 + 1200 = 2800 \\ \text{Reg} = \frac{2800 \times 100}{70} = 4000 $$

Exam Takeaway: Election questions me vote transfer ki theory directly fractions par execute karo.

questions_hin.q_hi: The ratio of the number of boys and girls in a school is 7:5. If $65\%$ of the boys and $81\%$ of the girls are scholarship holders, then the exact percentage of students who do NOT get a scholarship is:
questions_hin.s_hi:
The "Pen-Free" Observation First:

Dekh bhai, 'do NOT get scholarship' pucha hai. Pehle JSM laga ke total getting nikal, aur phir $100\%$ se minus kar de. Fraction minus karne me time waste nahi karna hai.

Method 1 (JSM Ninja Technique):

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Base } (\text{Getting}) = 65\% \\ \text{Extra in Girls} = 81\% - 65\% = +16\% \\ \text{Avg } (\text{Getting}) = 65\% + \frac{5 \times 16\%}{12} = 65\% + \frac{20}{3}\% = 71\frac{2}{3}\% \\ \text{NOT Getting} = 100\% - 71\frac{2}{3}\% \\ = (100 - 72) + (1 - \frac{2}{3}) = 28\frac{1}{3}\% $$

Exam Takeaway: Calculation mein jab bhi 100 mein se mixed fraction minus karna ho, toh integer ko ek aage badha ke subtract kar, aur fraction ka bacha gap chipka de!

questions_hin.q_hi: Two candidates P and Q are contesting elections in a city. $80\%$ of the registered voters voted in the election and P won the election by 160 votes. If Q had got $25\%$ more votes then the result of the election would have been a tie, then how many people did not vote?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: 4. Cross-Product Method / Ratio Balancing Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, thoda ghuma hua sawal hai. Tie ka matlab hota hai dono ke votes barabar ho jana. Par 'if Q got 25% more' ka assumption wahan ke fixed valid votes me P ka nuksan nahi dikha raha, bas usne bahar se votes cover kiye aise treat kar. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): P aur Q ka margin 160 tha. Yaani $P - Q = 160$. Tie karne ke liye Q ko P ke barabar aana hai, yani usey aur 160 votes chahiye the. Question kehta hai ki agar usko $25\%$ jyada milte toh tie hota. Iska matlab uske existing votes ka $25\%$ hi $160$ votes ke barabar hai! Yani $25\%$ of Q = 160 $\implies$ Q ke asal vote = $160 \times 4 = 640$. Toh P ke vote $= 640 + 160 = 800$. Total valid vote kitne pade? $800 + 640 = 1440$. Oye wait, result of election as tie meaning agar unhi casted votes me change hota toh? 'If Q had got 25% more votes... tie' means from the same pool. P se Q ki taraf shift hue! Agar shift hue toh margin cover hoga. Q ko mile $25\%$ zyada yani $0.25Q$. P ko itna hi loss hua hoga, tab dono barabar. Yani original gap $P - Q = 2 \times 0.25Q = 0.5Q$. Margin $160$ diya hai. $0.5Q = 160 \implies Q = 320$. P $= 480$. Total cast = $480 + 320 = 800$. Ye valid votes the (registered ke $80\%$). Toh register $= 1000$. Didn't vote ($20\%$) $= 200$. Concept hila dene wala sawal tha ye! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Equations bana le. P + Q = Total Voted. P - Q = 160. Nayi condition: $Q + 0.25Q = P - 0.25Q \implies P = 1.5Q$. Is value ko daal de $P - Q = 160$ me. $1.5Q - Q = 160 \implies 0.5Q = 160 \implies Q = 320$. Uske baad upar wali calculations lag jaayengi. Exam Takeaway: Election tie wale cases me jiska badh raha hai, utna hi dusre ka ghata kar gap cover karna hota hai!

2. Total Cast ($80\%$)800
3. Didn't Vote ($20\%$)200

questions_hin.q_hi: Rajan spent $10\%$ of his salary on rent. He spent $20\%$ of the remaining part of the salary on transport. After which he spent $40\%$ of the balance of the salary on food. Further, he spent $80\%$ of the balance on various bills. He deposits $\text{Rs. } 5000$ in the bank and kept the remaining $\text{Rs. } 1480$ for his own petty expenditure. Find his monthly salary (in Rs.).

Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction) Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, bar-bar 'remaining part' likha hai, seedha Successive Change ka chain lagana hai. End me jo bhi paisa bacha (bank me daala + khud rakha) wo sab final remainder hai. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Final amount bacha $5000 + 1480 = 6480$. Salary ko $S$ maan aur seedha bachi hui fractions likh: $10\%$ kharch $\to \frac{9}{10}$ bacha, $20\% \to \frac{4}{5}$, $40\% \to \frac{3}{5}$, $80\% \to \frac{1}{5}$. Equation bani: $S \times \frac{9}{10} \times \frac{4}{5} \times \frac{3}{5} \times \frac{1}{5} = 6480$. Upar walon ko multiply karega toh $9 \times 4 \times 3 = 108$ aayega. $108$ se $6480$ kata $60$ baar me. Yani $S \times 0.0864 = 6480$. $S = \frac{6480}{0.0864} = 75000$. Digital Sum bhi check kar sakta hai par itna sidha cut raha hai ki zaroorat nahi. $\frac{9}{10} \times \frac{4}{5} \times \frac{3}{5} \times \frac{1}{5}$$\frac{108}{1250}$
$S \times \frac{108}{1250} = 6480$$S = 75000$

questions_hin.q_hi: Two candidates contested an election. 10% of people on the voting list did not vote and 60 votes recorded were rejected as illegal. The majority of successful candidate was 308 and it was found that he had been supported by 47% of the whole number of the voter's list. What were the total votes.
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, winner ko total ka 47% mila hai. Loser ko bache hue valid votes milenge. Ye jo 60 invalid votes hain, ye directly loser ke khate se katenge jisse winner ka margin badh jayega.



Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Total votes ko 100x maan le. Winner le gaya 47x. Toh baaki bacha 43x. Agar sab sahi hota toh margin 4x hota. Par 60 votes invalid the, isiliye margin $308 - 60 = 248$ reh gaya. Seedha $4\% = 248 \implies 1\% = 62$. Toh total $100\% = 6200$. 10 second ka khel hai!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic se dekhe toh Total = $x$. Valid $= 0.9x - 60$. Winner $= 0.47x$. Loser ko mila $(0.9x - 60) - 0.47x = 0.43x - 60$. Ab equation bana: $0.47x - (0.43x - 60) = 308 \implies 0.04x = 248$.

Exam Takeaway: CGL me jab bhi absolute invalid votes diye hon, unhe margin me se minus karke percentage ke barabar rakh de.
